Guidance: Design a dashboard that helps leaders identify apparent strengths and opportunities in staff perceptions of safety culture.
Which aspects of safety culture appear strongest, and where should leaders investigate opportunities for improvement?
Executive leadership (organization-wide oversight) and clinical program managers (program/unit-level comparison).
All records are synthetic and educational. There is one cross-sectional survey sample, so trend-over-time analysis is not supported.
The Unit Participation sheet contains synthetic invitation and response counts. Response rates are illustrative and are not based on real organizational data.
Lower scores may suggest areas to explore, not prove causes. Reported-event counts are self-reported and should not be interpreted as a direct measure of safety culture or event incidence.
